entities.summary: Dean Daniel Oliver is an American former professional basketball player and assistant coach for the Wisconsin Badgers. An undrafted 5-foot-11-inch (1.80 m) point guard from the University of Iowa, Oliver played with the Golden State Warriors from 2001-02 to 2002-03.
